BiblicalUsage: The word ʼĕlôwahh carries the sense of the Deity. In Deuteronomy 32:15, the text says "then he forsook God [which] made him." In 2 Kings 17:31, the text says "the gods of Sepharvaim."
TheologicalSignificance: ʼĕlôwahh convinces me that God is who He says He is, and His name carries everything He is. That is why I keep this word in mind when I read those passages — it carries more than its size suggests.
RelatedEvents: Fall of Samaria; Hezekiah and Sennacherib's Invasion; Israel Renews the Covenant
